text:
jo: dropped a lightweight "route economics" card into staging. shows tokens, gross_cost, kv_hits, and a computed "shared_credit_est". live link: https://staging.redwood.internal/dash/route-econ-mini

indra: looks useful. a couple asks: 1) include provenance (sampled|aggregate|amortized_job) per row; 2) surface sample_rate; finance will want both for audits.

jo: will add both. current sampling is 0.25% full-trace + full counters for aggregate totals. API will return `provenance` and `sample_rate` fields per CSV row.

pat: about shared_credit_est 12: is that per-route naive split or an amortized algorithm? we've had trouble where prefetch is double-counted.

jo: prototype uses a simple time-window amortizer (5m) that splits credit across routes touching the same prefetch key, capped to top-75 owners with an "others" bucket. i left it off by default in the UI.

indra: UI suggestion: show raw_kv_hits column and an optional amortized column with a confidence badge (low/med/high). add a tooltip that explains negative values due to eviction+prefetch races.

jo: good call. feature flag `route_econ_amortized_v1` added; off in prod. also added tiny sparkline for token p95 over 1h.

audit-bot: deploy 6481239999-route-econ-mini -> staging success (9s)

pat: API detail: make the output flat for CSV consumers. no nested blobs. include `explain_inputs` as flattened k=val string so spreadsheets can replay assumptions.

jo: will emit `explain_inputs` and `schema_version`. also a short runbook note for interpreting negative amortized credits.

indra: schedule a 20m signoff with finance and observability before we flip the flag. i'll book.

jo: thanks all 14 :thumbsup:
